BLAKE3 hashing APIs, state structs, constants, and batch LtHash functions.

# Purpose
This header file defines the public interface for `fd_blake3`, which implements BLAKE3 hashing in C. It declares protocol constants, internal state structures, memory layout values, and the main API for creating a hash state, adding input with [`fd_blake3_append`](<#fd_blake3_append>), and finishing the hash with [`fd_blake3_fini`](<#fd_blake3_fini>) or [`fd_blake3_fini_2048`](<#fd_blake3_fini_2048>). The file also documents the BLAKE3 tree hash process and the internal use of state machines, schedulers, and SIMD backends for parallel processing. In addition, it provides batch LtHash helper functions for hashing multiple independent messages with AVX or AVX512 support.
